testPolicy.text: Wake Forest does not require the SAT or ACT (announced May 2008); international students whose first language is not English must submit TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo. The university emphasizes interviews in its holistic review.

cost.totalIncludes: living on or off campus: tuition 71,894 + fees 1,276 (activity, wellness, health service) + housing 12,900 + food 7,396 + personal 1,930 + transportation 1,550 + federal direct loan average fee 64 + books, course materials, supplies and equipment 1,720 = 98,730. New students also pay a 380 orientation fee in the first semester (not in the total). The admissions page labels these 2026-27 costs.

aidPromise.text: Wake Forest is committed to meeting 100 percent of demonstrated need with a combination of grants, scholarships, work study, and loans.

deadlines.early: November 15 (Early Decision I, decisions on a rolling basis; Early Action for first-generation college students only, decision by January 15); January 1 (Early Decision II, decision by February 15)

facts.text: Wake Forest has been test-optional since the class entering in fall 2009, one of the earliest highly selective universities to drop the requirement.
Early Decision I decisions are released on a rolling basis from early fall, and the non-binding Early Action round is reserved for first-generation college students.
For fall 2025, Wake Forest admitted 4,068 of 19,595 first-year applicants and enrolled 1,544.
The 2026-27 estimated cost of attendance is $98,730, of which $73,170 is tuition and fees.
Wake Forest meets 100 percent of demonstrated need, but the package can include work study and loans, and merit scholarships are described as very selective.

notes: The CDS 2025-26 PDF is a fillable form; values were read from its form fields. C1: applied 8,235 men + 11,360 women = 19,595; admitted 1,965 + 2,103 = 4,068; enrolled (full-time) 676 + 868 = 1,544; the CDS total fields themselves read 0 and the unknown-sex applied/admitted fields were not filled. CDS C21 reports ED I closing November 15 and ED II January 1 but leaves ED application and admit counts blank; C2 waiting-list counts blank. CDS G (2026-27) gives food 10,530 (board only) vs 7,396 on the financial aid page; the financial aid page was used. The financial aid page does not print the year, but its figures match the admissions page labelled 2026-27 (total 98,730). No official fall 2026 figures found. No residency counts in the CDS form.
